title: Six Words for Where It Hurts
label: ch:hi-where-it-hurts
canDo: I can name six parts of my body, say that one of them is not well, and tell which three are word-for-word cousins of their English translations — and which one has no traceable ancestry at all.

payoff.summary: Say all six body words with the possessive each one demands — मेरा सिर, मेरा हाथ, मेरी आँख, मेरा दाँत, मेरा पैर, मेरा पेट — then say मेरा पेट ठीक नहीं है, and separate the three exact Indo-European cousins from the two words, पेट and रोटी, whose histories genuinely stop.
